question: Does applying the same terminal readout to original versus updated encoder descriptors change the observed selection geometry?
parent_repair: Reject CPU readout for stale descriptors: use the same CUDA FP32 readout and normalization as the accepted fresh-export path. Scoring remains the original CPU scorer. No encoder construction, image access, optimizer, training, VAL or official read.
inputs: Accepted full score+fullCPU+four full export receipts; four exact bundle manifests+endpoint.pt; original partition/FIT/cache/control scope; exact pinned constructor/readout/packing/scorer/runtime/native authority files only. No blanket inherited input-guard traversal.
admission: Authenticate complete score/export/bundle/CPU member bindings and typed endpoint state; current KILL is admitted only as a diagnostic input, never GO.
Reproduce all four accepted per-query R1 and AP arrays exactly and exact raw/unit/packed file mappings before new readouts.
Control terminal readouts on original cached features must match accepted control raw/unit bits and codes/inverses/wire and per-query R1/AP; report differences and stop on mismatch.
Process original B32 roles including tails6/19; repeat independent readout reloads exactly; original require predicates and numerical flags remain.
Bind exact original runtime/native authority; no new executable/native grants. Reuse pinned source validation, with scope concretely documented before code is frozen.
readout: Per candidate seed, S=terminal candidate readout over original cache and F=accepted current candidate descriptors. Evaluate SS/SF/FS/FF by exact original panel order and unchanged CPU packed scorer; FF must replay originals.
outputs: Descriptive full per-query arrays, seed-separated differences and interaction, instrument differences, runtime/resource/cleanup/integrity receipt. No thresholds, automatic compression/pose/gallery training action, survivor or causal-null claim.
falsifiers: Real extracted original seams with stdlib standins; interleaved roles, unequal inverse norms, signed ties, R1-preserving AP change, wrong wire/endian/row/member/omittedC/wrongmu; deny image/model opens; validate independent reload, RNG, cleanup, cap and uncached allowlist exit; preserve original source modules/globals.
stop: Any metadata/byte/tap/arithmetic/resource/lifetime failure stops the diagnostic. Original failure stays failure. Passing only yields descriptive evidence for a separately reviewed next mechanism.
remaining_confound: FIT export batch composition and original versus selection preprocessing must pass complete control tap checks. Passing controls does not prove all possible candidate arithmetic equivalence; same-device source order removes the known CPU/CUDA confound.
